inlines.v: AB'LUENT, adjective [Latin abluo, to wash away; ab and luo, or lavo, to wash.] Washing clean; cleansing by water or liquids. [Little used except as a noun.] AB'LUENT, noun In medicine, that which thins, purifies or sweetens the blood. [See diluent and Abstergent.]
